This story proves the four states in the SIT smoke profile and in the panels; it builds no screen and fixes no field, and the panels of the app story are its only consumer.
edits.new: SCR-44 Interface and job monitor in its four states — Running, failed, waiting for the ACE batch, complete — is served through the gateway-bff composite route (DP-19). This story proves the four states in the SIT smoke profile and in the panels; it builds no screen and fixes no field, and the panels of the app story are its only consumer. Empty, loading, error and no access states: Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-1863). This story registers the gateway-bff composite route for SCR-44 and its alerts; RWB-P1-AD018-APP serves the reads and RWB-P1-AD018-CON publishes them (GAP-0516).
